name: Davion Flood
content: Hi! I'm Davion, but I'm better known as Pâro. I'm a third year Business Management Economics student and serve as the President of Slug Gaming. In my free time, I play Street Fighter, Apex Legends, and Pokemon and can be found frequently complaining about my lack of wins. I'm looking forward to another great year of competitive gaming, raffles, and trying to convince my friends to play fighting games with me.
